song.title: Have You Ever Seen The Rain

guitar.notes: Fogerty used several guitars over CCR's career (Rickenbacker, Les Paul, Kustom K200); no single fully dominant model, medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: jangly clean-breakup rhythm with light chorus
tone.profile: jangly clean-breakup rhythm with light chorus
tone.summary: A classic folk-rock setup using a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe/Silver Twin) paired with Chorus for the signature jangly sound.
